The structure of Cs2Ag2As2F12 (reduced formula CsAgAsF6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ag and As centers, each coordinated by six F neighbors, alongside a single Cs environment with eight F neighbors. Ag- and As-centered octahedra share corners, while Cs polyhedra share corners and faces with both Ag and As octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites.
